basic_info.description: 1871 45th Avenue  a classic Outer Sunset home with incredible potential just steps from Ocean Beach. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers 800 sq ft of living space on a generous 2,996 sq ft lot, providing plenty of room to create the coastal lifestyle youve always envisioned. This property is ideal for buyers seeking a project with long-term rewards. With its unbeatable location, youll enjoy easy access to Golden Gate Park, Lands End, the SF Zoo, and a wide array of local shops, schools, and eateries. The neighborhoods laid-back vibe, coupled with ocean breezes and gorgeous sunsets, makes it one of the citys most desirable communities. With a little vision and care, 1871 45th Avenue is ready to be transformed into a modern coastal retreat or a charming family home. Dont miss this opportunity to invest in San Franciscos vibrant Outer Sunset.
